eight-of-wands.advice: Now is the time to turn your preparations into action without delay. As things unfold quickly, respond with flexibility, but keep an eye on the important details so nothing slips through the cracks. Like wands sailing smoothly beneath a clear sky, embracing the current pace with openness rather than fear can lead to good outcomes.

ten-of-wands.name: Ten of Wands
ten-of-wands.meaning: This card symbolizes overload, the weight of responsibility, and stubborn persistence. It represents carrying too much burden alone, being nearly at the destination but utterly exhausted. It suggests considering sharing the load or letting go of what's unnecessary. Rather than trying to handle everything by yourself, seek help or sort out your priorities.
ten-of-wands.sym_person: A figure struggling forward while carrying a bundle of ten wands
ten-of-wands.sym_symbol: A heavy bundle of wands, a village visible in the distance
ten-of-wands.upright: The Ten of Wands shows a figure trudging forward in silence under a burden too heavy for two arms to hold, depicting a state where responsibility and pressure have reached their peak. The village visible in the distance means the goal is within sight, but it also suggests that the fatigue and pressure accumulated so far have reached their maximum point as well. This card speaks not simply of a difficult situation, but of how the attitude of trying to carry everything alone is making things heavier than they need to be. Just as the view is blocked by the bundle of wands despite the open field, you are likely focused only on the burden right in front of you rather than the bigger picture. It's understandable not to want to give up with the finish line so close, but now is the time to check whether you can actually make it to the end this way.
ten-of-wands.reversed: The reversed Ten of Wands indicates two possible directions at once: beginning to set the burden down, or conversely, collapsing under its weight. It may be a sign that the time has come to share or sort out responsibilities you've carried alone for a long time, which should be seen not as retreat but as wise reorganization. On the other hand, if you simply keep enduring and holding on, there's a risk of burnout or sudden abandonment. What's needed now is to coolly distinguish what to keep carrying and what to set down.
ten-of-wands.love: If you've been shouldering all the conflict and responsibility in a relationship alone, this card signals that it's now time to share that weight with your partner. If excessive devotion is draining you, it's worth examining how the burden is being distributed before examining the relationship itself. Honestly voicing your burden can be the starting point for making the relationship healthier.
ten-of-wands.career: This card shows a state of exhaustion from taking on too many roles alone in work or a project. With the goal so close, you may feel like pushing through just a little longer, but considering collaboration or delegation could lead to better results in the long run. Now is the time to sort out priorities and focus your energy only on what truly matters.
ten-of-wands.money: Financially, this may indicate a state of mounting pressure from multiple expenses or obligations overlapping at once. If you're carrying several burdens simultaneously—loans, living expenses, investments—it helps to set priorities and address them one at a time. Rather than forcing yourself to resolve everything at once, a gradual approach to easing the burden is needed.
ten-of-wands.advice: Try distinguishing which of the burdens you're currently carrying truly need to be carried to the end, and which can be set down. Letting go of the habit of trying to solve everything alone and asking those around you for help is also a courageous choice. With the destination so close, finding a way to walk the remaining path more lightly is the key task at hand.

page-of-wands.name: Page of Wands
page-of-wands.meaning: This card symbolizes a passionate explorer, the seed of a creative idea, and excitement about something new. There is abundant energy and curiosity, though experience is still lacking. It marks a time when you feel the urge to begin a new adventure or creative pursuit—ideas are overflowing but have not yet taken concrete shape. It is time to take that first step toward infinite possibility.
page-of-wands.sym_person: A young figure standing in the middle of a desert, holding a wand and gazing upward
page-of-wands.sym_symbol: A tunic patterned with salamanders, a feathered hat, a wand sprouting new growth
page-of-wands.sym_bg: A desert with pyramids visible in the distance
page-of-wands.upright: The image of a young person standing in the vast desert, raising a wand and looking up at the sky, shows a pure longing to move toward something—even without yet knowing exactly where to go. The salamander-patterned tunic represents the flexibility to adapt to ever-changing circumstances, while the feathered hat symbolizes an imagination that wanders freely. The sprout growing from the wand in their hand signifies an idea that is still fragile but undeniably alive—a possibility that has only just begun. If you've drawn this card, there's a good chance that excitement about something new—a new endeavor, a new encounter, new learning—is stirring within you right now. It's fine if you lack experience or certainty. This is not the stage of completion, but of beginning.
page-of-wands.reversed: Reversed, the Page of Wands represents energy that is passionate but scattered, lacking direction. Like the scorching heat of the desert, your heart may burn with enthusiasm, yet that fire may fail to translate into real action, or you may fall into a pattern of starting something impulsively only to lose interest soon after. Sometimes unfounded rumors, hasty judgments, or immature planning can lead to unexpected mistakes. At times like this, you need to pause and ask yourself again what it is you truly want.
page-of-wands.love: In love, this card represents an early stage filled with excitement and curiosity, or the moment your heart begins to turn toward someone. The relationship may not yet be defined, and you may still be in a phase of exploring each other, but that pure flutter of excitement itself can be a meaningful sign. However, rather than rushing forward carried away by emotion, nurturing your feelings slowly, like a sprout growing, will make the relationship healthier.
page-of-wands.career: In work or career matters, this card suggests a strong curiosity about a new project or field, or a challenge in a completely different direction. You may still lack a concrete plan or experience, but that very passion is what drives you forward right now. Like gazing at the pyramids from the desert, the goal may be far away, but what matters most at this stage is the courage to take the first step.
page-of-wands.money: In financial matters, this may signify a time when interest in a new source of income or investment idea is beginning to sprout. However, since it remains unproven, it's safer to gather information and try small steps rather than impulsively moving large sums of money. If you begin carefully, like planting a seed, it may lead to meaningful growth over time.
page-of-wands.advice: Don't suppress the curiosity and excitement stirring within you right now—acknowledge it as it is. You don't need a perfect plan; what matters is taking even one small action to turn that energy into reality. Like the figure standing in the middle of the desert, the attitude you need right now is the courage to look upward and take that first step, even amid uncertainty.

nine-of-wands.name: Nine of Wands
nine-of-wands.meaning: This card symbolizes resilience, vigilance, and a last stand. It represents the persistence of someone who has endured many hardships and grown weary, yet refuses to give up. It reflects a state of being defensive due to past wounds, while standing just one step away from reaching the goal. If you can hold on a little longer, just as you have endured so far, results are sure to come.
nine-of-wands.sym_person: A man with a bandaged head standing cautiously, leaning on a staff
nine-of-wands.sym_symbol: A hand gripping the ninth wand tightly, eight wands lined up behind him
nine-of-wands.upright: The man with the bandaged head has already weathered several clashes, yet he still refuses to let go of the ninth wand in his hand. This reflects a determination not to let the eight wands he has already built up—the time and effort he has endured—go to waste. His body is exhausted, and his watchful eyes betray uncertainty about what might happen next, but that vigilance doesn't stem from fear; it comes from a will to protect everything he's achieved so far. This card signals a moment when you must hold your last line of defense even while not fully recovered, or a point where things could settle if you just hold on a bit longer. Standing on rough terrain suggests that the road ahead may still not be smooth, but the very experience of having walked that path is itself a source of strength now.
nine-of-wands.reversed: In reverse, this card evokes the moment the man finally lets go of the last wand he was holding. It can indicate that constant tension and a defensive stance have led to burnout, or an oversensitive reaction to even minor provocations. It may also be worth examining whether excessive vigilance is pushing away help or good opportunities that are actually trying to reach you. At times, this card can be a signal that it's now okay to lay down your weapon and rest, that it's time to fully release your defensive posture.
nine-of-wands.love: Having already gone through a few disappointments or conflicts in the relationship, you may find yourself keeping your heart only half-open while you watch the other person carefully. Like the bandaged head, there may be wounds that haven't fully healed yet, making you appear guarded—but what matters is that you haven't completely given up on the relationship. If you can open your heart to the other person just a little more, or separate past wounds from who they are now, there's room for the relationship to move forward to its next stage.
nine-of-wands.career: This can indicate standing at a final critical juncture after enduring repeated trial and error and pressure in a project or at work. If you let go now simply because things feel hard, the eight wands you've built up—the results of your effort—could fall apart, so you need the attitude to hold on just a bit longer. That said, rather than trying to defend everything alone, letting others know your situation and asking for help can also be a way to reach the end without burning out.
nine-of-wands.money: This may be a period where, after experiencing several financial losses or pressures, you're taking a cautious and defensive stance to protect what remains of your assets or plans. Cutting spending and staying alert to risk are reasonable choices given the circumstances, but it's worth checking whether excessive anxiety is causing you to delay even necessary decisions. If you hold on a little longer and stick to your plan, you may reach the point where your careful management finally bears fruit.
nine-of-wands.advice: Remember that the fatigue you feel right now isn't proof of failure—it's proof of how far you've come. To avoid completely breaking down, take a moment to catch your breath, but be careful not to let go of the last wand in your hand too soon. At the same time, you don't need to stay on guard every single moment, so try practicing letting your guard down little by little in relationships or situations that feel safe.

knight-of-wands.name: Knight of Wands
knight-of-wands.meaning: This card symbolizes a spirit of adventure, impulsive action, and fiery passion. It represents energy and strong charisma that moves quickly and boldly, embracing the thrill of life. However, while beginnings may be dazzling, follow-through can be weak. It's important to channel that passionate energy while maintaining the consistency to see things through to the end.
knight-of-wands.sym_person: A knight wearing salamander armor, riding a horse at full gallop with a wand held high
knight-of-wands.sym_symbol: Salamander armor, a yellow flame-patterned cloak, a horse surging with movement
knight-of-wands.upright: The knight, holding his wand high atop a galloping horse racing through the middle of the desert, shows the energy of charging toward one's goal without hesitation. The salamander armor symbolizes adaptability that survives in ever-changing environments, while the yellow flame cloak represents irrepressible passion and charisma. When this card appears, there's a strong chance that a new challenge or sudden opportunity is entering your life right now, setting your heart ablaze. This is a period when the drive to leap in first and plan later grows stronger, and that boldness can bring fresh stimulation and excitement to those around you. However, like the desert setting, running for too long can leave you exhausted, so it's worth considering together how to sustain that initial spark.
knight-of-wands.reversed: The reversed Knight of Wands suggests a situation like a horse galloping so fast it loses its balance—where haste and impulsiveness end up working against you. When passion outpaces planning or patience, what you've started may fizzle out or hit obstacles along the way. This is also a moment when your fiery nature might turn into impatience or irritability, potentially causing friction with those around you. It seems like a time to slow down and check whether the direction you're racing toward is truly the right one.
knight-of-wands.love: In matters of love, this card can signify an encounter as hot and thrilling as a flame, or a rapid progression of emotions. Your attraction to the other person grows strong enough that you want to actively pursue them, but whether that heat will last is a separate matter worth watching closely. If you want to deepen the relationship, it may help to pair momentary excitement with steady attention and effort over time.
knight-of-wands.career: At work or in your career path, a new project or challenging opportunity may stimulate you, increasing your desire to act boldly. You can take the lead and drive situations forward with initiative and leadership, but diving in without detailed planning carries the risk of losing steam midway. Finding the balance between harnessing your initial drive and keeping pace with those you work with can lead to real results.
knight-of-wands.money: Financially, this may be a period when sudden urges to invest or spend grow stronger, with an impulse to boldly bet on challenging opportunities. Quick decisions could lead to good outcomes, but jumping in without sufficient review may saddle you with greater risk than expected. Before getting swept up in passion, pausing to check the numbers and the realities of the situation could prove helpful.
knight-of-wands.advice: The passion and drive burning within you right now are a great asset, so don't be afraid to move forward. That said, direction matters as much as speed, so take a moment to confirm your destination before you start running. If you add a bit of patience to carry that initial spark all the way through, that energy can lead to far more solid results.

king-of-wands.name: King of Wands
king-of-wands.meaning: This card symbolizes a visionary leader, entrepreneurial energy, and mature passion. It represents charisma and leadership refined through experience, along with the ability to turn creative vision into reality. You possess a natural leadership that inspires and guides others. It is a time to clarify your vision and lead with confidence.
king-of-wands.sym_person: A king holding a wand, seated on a throne decorated with lizard and lion motifs
king-of-wands.sym_symbol: A cloak of flames, a wand sprouting new growth, a small lizard near his feet
king-of-wands.upright: The King of Wands sits unshaken upon his throne even amid the harsh desert environment, demonstrating mature leadership that never loses its direction no matter the circumstances. The flame cloak wrapped around him speaks to how the passion burning within has transformed from mere impulse into a power he can now command, while the sprouting wand in his hand symbolizes that this passion has not lost its vitality but continues to grow. The small lizard at his feet represents the wisdom of adapting to an ever-changing environment, and the fact that the king keeps it near without fear shows his ease in handling uncertainty. When this card appears, it suggests that now is the time to stop holding ideas only in your head and instead step forward to guide others with the confidence born of experience. The vision within you has already been sufficiently refined, and this is a period when the charisma and resolve needed to put it into action will naturally emerge.
king-of-wands.reversed: When fiery energy goes unchecked, passion can turn into self-righteousness or impatient coercion, and the reversed King of Wands warns of this danger. Just as the desert's heat can become excessive and scorch everything around it, pushing your beliefs too hard without listening to others' opinions, or letting excessive confidence slide into arrogance, may become an issue. Conversely, you might see a loss of the throne's authority, leadership that wavers without clear direction, or an impatience that prevents you from carrying a vision through to completion. If this card appears reversed, it would be wise to reflect on finding balance between your own passion and the pace of those around you.
king-of-wands.love: In relationships, the King of Wands shows a charming and proactive attitude of leading with confidence, suggesting a time when you can offer both stability and passion to your partner at once. However, if this strong energy fails to consider your partner's pace and insists on steering the relationship entirely your own way, it may start to feel burdensome, so balance is needed. If you are already in a relationship, this points toward a mature partnership that supports mutual growth; if you are seeking someone new, your confident and take-charge attitude may work in your favor as an attractive quality.
king-of-wands.career: In work or career matters, this card shows that years of experience and effort have accumulated to the point where you are now ready to speak up as a leader, suggesting a time when you can concretely apply your vision to a team or project. Even in situations as uncertain and challenging as a desert, maintaining an unwavering attitude while offering direction can earn you the trust of those around you. If you are considering starting a business or taking on a new challenge, your current charisma and execution ability can serve as valuable assets supporting that beginning.
king-of-wands.money: Financially, this is a period when long-held plans and preparations can lead to tangible results, and bold yet careful judgment can prove powerful in investment or business decisions. Just as the lizard adapts to its changing surroundings, you need to respond flexibly to market shifts while maintaining your overall sense of direction. However, rather than attempting reckless expansion out of excessive confidence, making calculated decisions grounded in your accumulated experience is more likely to lead to stable results.
king-of-wands.advice: It is time to stop hiding the experience and passion you have built up and instead speak up with your own voice to offer direction. Rather than using your fiery energy to scorch those around you, use it as a warm light to guide them. Remember the lizard's adaptability even in harsh environments, and try to hold both conviction and flexibility together.

two-of-cups.name: Two of Cups
two-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes mutual love, partnership, and harmonious connection. It represents a genuine bond, deep understanding between two people, and beautiful balance and mutual respect in a relationship. It may signal the beginning of a new relationship or a deepening of an existing one. Cherish heartfelt connection and nurture a relationship where both people see each other as equals.
two-of-cups.sym_person: A man and woman facing each other, each holding a cup
two-of-cups.sym_symbol: Two cups, a caduceus with a lion's head, a wreath of flowers
two-of-cups.upright: The image of two people facing each other, exchanging cups, shows the starting point of a relationship built on give and take rather than one-sided effort. As one person offers a cup and the other extends theirs in return, it signifies that both are sharing their hearts with roughly equal weight, rather than one person carrying the relationship alone. The caduceus and lion's head above suggest that two beings with different personalities and temperaments are achieving balance through their differences rather than conflict. The warm background adorned with a wreath of flowers shows that this meeting is ripening naturally rather than being forced, and suggests that mutual respect forms the foundation of the relationship. Whether this is the moment a new bond is budding with someone, or an existing relationship is deepening to another level, it can be seen as a point where sincerity is meeting sincerity.
two-of-cups.reversed: In reverse, this can be read as a moment when the gazes of the two people who once faced each other begin to drift apart. It may indicate that only one side is offering the cup, or that the warmth between the two has grown uneven, throwing off the balance. It could reflect accumulated misunderstandings that haven't been resolved through conversation, or a situation where one person keeps accommodating the other until they grow exhausted. However, this is closer to a temporary loss of rhythm than a complete break, so it may be a good time to look back and see where the balance started to shift.
two-of-cups.love: For those already in a relationship, this may be a time of feeling confident that hearts are truly connecting with each other. For those without a partner, it may be worth looking forward to a natural beginning with someone of a similar nature. If it's unrequited love, the other person may be gradually sending signs of opening their heart. However, if reversed, checking whether the balance in communication has been disrupted could be key to restoring the relationship.
two-of-cups.career: At work, relationships with collaborating colleagues or partners may proceed smoothly, creating good teamwork built on mutual respect for each other's roles. This can also be interpreted as a flow toward a new business partnership or contract coming together, which is a positive sign if you're looking for someone to work with. If reversed, it may be worth checking whether the division of roles in a collaborative relationship has become unbalanced.
two-of-cups.money: Financially, this suggests that sharing profits with someone, or forming a financial union through joint investment or partnership, may flow favorably. Transactions or negotiations built on trust are likely to proceed smoothly. However, if reversed, it would be wise to clearly define terms so that money matters don't disrupt the balance of the relationship.
two-of-cups.advice: This may be a time when working together with someone to build something brings better results than struggling alone. If you offer a small gesture of trust first, like extending your own cup, the other person is likely to respond in kind. However, it's important to keep watching the balance of give and take so that the relationship doesn't tip too far to one side.

three-of-cups.name: Three of Cups
three-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes friendship, community, and shared joy. It represents happy moments shared with loved ones, teamwork, and achievement through cooperation. A festive energy overflows as people gather together to celebrate. Now is a time to share and celebrate joy not alone, but with the people who matter to you.
three-of-cups.sym_person: Three women dancing together while raising their cups
three-of-cups.sym_symbol: Three raised cups, decorated with flowers and fruit
three-of-cups.upright: The sight of three women raising their cups and coming together in harmony shows a moment of joy that could never be complete alone. The essence of this card is having someone to share good news with, and knowing that sharing multiplies that joy many times over. The abundant background decorated with flowers and fruit tells us we fully deserve to enjoy the fruits of our hard work, and that now is not the time to quietly savor an achievement alone, but to celebrate it with those around us. Friendship, cooperation, and a sense of belonging within community are especially emphasized, and you may find more joy and support than expected in recent gatherings or relationships. This card also suggests that teamwork and collaboration can produce results that would have been difficult to reach through individual effort alone.
three-of-cups.reversed: In reverse, this may indicate that the festive mood has become somewhat excessive, or that togetherness has started to feel draining rather than fulfilling. Just as the three cups appear unsteady, subtle conflicts or feelings of exclusion may surface within a group, or relationships that seem warm on the surface may not be what they appear. It's worth reflecting on whether excessive socializing or constantly accommodating others has left you neglecting your own energy. This card can also hint at imbalance arising from a triangular dynamic or the involvement of a third party, so it may help to examine who you're spending your time with and how.
three-of-cups.love: For couples, this shows a flow where the relationship grows stronger not just through time spent alone together, but through moments shared with friends and family. For singles, there's a chance a new connection could begin through gatherings or being introduced by acquaintances, so opening yourself up a bit more to social activities could help. However, in reverse, there's a possibility the relationship could become complicated due to a triangular situation or the involvement of someone else, so it would be wise to set clear boundaries.
three-of-cups.career: At work, this is a period when good results are more likely to come from team projects and collaboration rather than individual effort. Relationships with colleagues tend to be harmonious, and you may find yourself recognized or celebrated for work accomplished together. That said, it's important to maintain balance so you don't lose sight of work priorities amid an overly sociable atmosphere.
three-of-cups.money: Financially, this card points to potential gains from joint investments, partnerships, or projects involving multiple people. Expenses may increase due to occasions worth celebrating, such as gatherings or parties, so it would be wise to plan your budget ahead of time. In reverse, clear communication is needed to avoid misunderstandings or imbalances in managing shared funds.
three-of-cups.advice: Remember that now is a time to move forward together with those around you, rather than struggling on your own. Even a small achievement means so much more when shared with the people who matter to you. That said, make sure to leave room to care for yourself, so you don't lose your own center even while being together with others.

four-of-cups.name: Four of Cups
four-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes dissatisfaction, inner reflection, and a failure to recognize new opportunities. It represents a state where a feeling that what one already has isn't enough, combined with apathy, causes the possibilities around oneself to go unnoticed. While time for self-reflection is needed, sinking too long into one's inner world carries risk. Lift your eyes and notice the signs of new opportunity.
four-of-cups.sym_person: A man sitting with arms crossed, turning away from the three cups before him
four-of-cups.sym_symbol: Three cups, a fourth cup being offered from a cloud
four-of-cups.upright: Beneath a tree, a man sits with arms crossed, lost in deep thought, not even looking at the three cups placed before him. This represents a moment when the things already in hand no longer move the heart, when familiarity has turned into boredom. At this moment, someone offers a fourth cup from within a cloud, but he fails to notice it—symbolizing a situation where new possibility has already arrived before his eyes, yet he remains trapped within himself, unable to see it. This is a time to seriously ask yourself what you truly lack, and what is failing to fulfill you. However, the longer reflection drags on, the deeper isolation can become, so you must not remain lost in thought forever—eventually you need to lift your head.
four-of-cups.reversed: The reversed position shows a gradual movement away from prolonged lethargy and stagnation. It can indicate one of two currents: the moment of uncrossing one's arms and beginning to notice the hand reaching out from the cloud, or conversely, sinking even deeper into boredom and self-isolation. The former signals readiness to open your heart to new opportunities or feelings, while the latter may be a warning that apathy is hardening into cynicism or disconnection. It's worth checking for yourself which direction you're currently moving in.
four-of-cups.love: If you're feeling boredom or a subtle dissatisfaction in your current relationship, it's worth first distinguishing whether this stems from your partner or from within yourself. If you're single, someone may be approaching you, but with your heart closed off, you may not be noticing it—so try uncrossing your arms and looking around. The relationship itself may not be over; you may simply have grown numb to familiar feelings. Rather than jumping to hasty conclusions, taking time to pause and look into your true feelings will help.
four-of-cups.career: You may currently find yourself in a state of lethargy, feeling no particular stimulation or meaning in your work. It's also possible that a new proposal or opportunity has already appeared before you, but you haven't seriously considered it because you're trapped in familiar dissatisfaction. What's needed now is to clearly identify the reasons for your discontent, then broaden your view and take another look at the options you may have been overlooking.
four-of-cups.money: Financially, this isn't a major crisis, but you may be feeling a vague dissatisfaction or boredom with your current situation, and not actively seeking new sources of income or opportunity. You may be dismissively passing over conditions or offers that aren't actually bad, so it's worth reconsidering even opportunities that seem minor. Rather than dwelling in feelings of dissatisfaction, it's more productive right now to specifically examine what is actually lacking.
four-of-cups.advice: Taking time to pause and look within is necessary, but staying there too long means missing the opportunity right in front of you. Like the hand reaching out from the cloud, help or change may come in an unexpected form—so uncross your arms and look around you. Understand clearly what dissatisfies you about what you currently have, but make sure it doesn't become an excuse to turn away from new possibilities.

six-of-cups.name: Six of Cups
six-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes nostalgia, memory, and pure joy. It carries a warm energy that comes from childhood memories or beautiful moments from the past. It represents a gift or reunion originating from the past, or a return to an innocent state of heart. Draw comfort from warm memories of the past, but bring that energy into your present life as well.
six-of-cups.sym_person: A boy handing a cup filled with flowers to a girl
six-of-cups.sym_symbol: Six cups filled with flowers, two children
six-of-cups.sym_bg: A warm, old village that evokes nostalgia
six-of-cups.upright: The Six of Cups is a card about traveling back in time to a moment when your heart felt at ease. Like the scene of a boy handing a girl a cup filled with flowers, the pure, unconditional giving and receiving of the past may resurface in your current situation. The warm backdrop of an old village shows that nostalgia doesn't have to be a negative emotion—it can be a source of comfort and stability. Reuniting with an old friend, picking up a forgotten hobby, or a childhood memory that suddenly surfaces can fill your present heart with warmth. However, this card isn't a suggestion to stay in the past; it's better read as a signal to bring that pure energy into your current life and put it to use.
six-of-cups.reversed: Reversed, the Six of Cups may indicate being too caught up in the past to move forward. Longing for better days can become a way of avoiding the present, or it may show up as lingering attachment to a relationship or situation that has already ended. Conversely, it could mean you've completely forgotten your roots or the innocence of childhood and are living in an overly practical, dried-out way. In such cases, it helps to treat the past only as a reference point and practice letting go of those feelings to plant your feet firmly in the present.
six-of-cups.love: In love, this card may suggest feelings as pure as first love, or the possibility of reuniting with a former partner. If you're already in a relationship, this is a good time to reflect on how you treat each other by recalling the excitement and consideration you felt when you first met. However, be careful not to lean solely on fond memories while avoiding present issues—effort is needed to actually bring that warmth into the relationship as it is now.
six-of-cups.career: For questions about work or career, this can be read as a message to recall the work you once loved or the initial enthusiasm you felt at your first job. There's also a possibility that former colleagues or connections may reconnect, bringing unexpected help or opportunities. If you're facing a new challenge, remembering the pure passion you had when you first started can help guide your direction now.
six-of-cups.money: Financially, past saving habits, help you once received, or an investment or contract made long ago may take on new significance again. There's also an open possibility of receiving an unexpected financial gift or support from family or someone close to you. However, rather than repeating past spending habits or generosity out of nostalgia, balance is needed to adjust them to fit your current situation.
six-of-cups.advice: Take a moment now to recall a memory from the past when your heart felt at ease, and examine what emotion was held within it. Rather than leaving that feeling as mere longing, try reviving it in some small form within today's relationships or choices. Remember that the goal is to restore that pure state of heart, not to return completely to that time.

ace-of-cups.name: Ace of Cups
ace-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes a new emotional beginning, intuition, and the blossoming of love. It represents a moment when the heart opens and deep feelings well up, marking the start of creative inspiration, spiritual connection, and the possibility of love. It is a wellspring of emotion overflowing with joy and happiness. Open your heart wide now and embrace this new current of feeling.
ace-of-cups.sym_symbol: A cup overflowing from a hand emerging from clouds, a dove holding a communion wafer, five fountains, a lotus flower
ace-of-cups.sym_bg: A lotus pond beneath a clear sky
ace-of-cups.upright: In this scene, a hand reaching through the clouds holds up a cup from which water overflows, depicting the moment when emotion rises so fully that it naturally spills forth. Whether it concerns feelings for someone, a new connection, or emotions long suppressed, this is a sign that there is no longer any need to hold back—you may now express yourself naturally. The dove carrying the communion wafer suggests that this emotional beginning goes beyond mere excitement, hinting at a sacred and pure dimension of connection, while the five streams pouring from the fountain represent an abundant flow in which both the senses and the heart open simultaneously. This is a time when it is alright to follow your heart without calculating or holding back, and whatever is beginning—whether creative work, a relationship, or spirituality—is likely to bring fresh vitality. Like the lotus blooming above the pond, this card quietly tells us that clear, new emotions can blossom even after rising from a muddy past.
ace-of-cups.reversed: When the cup turns upside down, the water that once overflowed can no longer flow freely—it either pools or leaks away, showing a state in which emotions become blocked or sink inward without being expressed. You may find yourself clenching your hand shut, afraid of being hurt even though you wish to open your heart, or conversely, you may experience confusion from emotions overflowing so much that you cannot contain them yourself. Even as a new beginning approaches, hesitation or a sense of emptiness may settle in, making it feel as though love or creative inspiration isn't coming easily. In times like this, rather than forcing feelings out, it helps to first look inward and examine what is blocking the flow.
ace-of-cups.love: This is a flow in which a new meeting may begin, or a forgotten spark may be rekindled within an existing relationship. Since the heart has already opened, expressing what you feel honestly now—rather than putting it off—can deepen the relationship further. However, in reversed position, you may be afraid to reveal your feelings or may be misreading the other person's heart, so it may be necessary to take time to first sort out your own true emotions.
ace-of-cups.career: At work as well, this is a time when new ideas or projects may seem to spring up spontaneously from within, and you may find a good flow especially in fields where creativity and communication matter. A sincere attitude toward colleagues or superiors can also help build trust, so an open-hearted approach to collaboration is more favorable than a rigid one. In reversed position, you may feel motivated but unable to find direction, spinning your wheels without progress, so it helps to start small—expressing and trying things—to get the flow moving again.
ace-of-cups.money: Financially, this is a period when you may naturally want to spend resources on what your heart is drawn to rather than careful calculation, and this is not necessarily a bad sign—it may mark the start of investing in a new opportunity or relationship. Still, rather than spending impulsively out of emotion, it helps to maintain balance by occasionally checking whether this flow holds meaning in the long term as well. In reversed position, there may be a tendency to fill emotional emptiness through spending, so it helps to ask yourself what is really motivating your purchases.
ace-of-cups.advice: Now is not the time to keep your heart's door closed—it is time to open it, even just a little. Your feelings don't need to be perfectly sorted out; trust what flows out of you and try expressing it as it is. That small opening may lead to a flow far larger and clearer than you expect.

eight-of-cups.name: Eight of Cups
eight-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes departure, the search for deeper meaning, and transformation rather than abandonment. It represents the decision to leave despite material sufficiency, when emotional or spiritual fulfillment is lacking. It speaks of the courage to leave behind what appears stable in order to seek what you truly desire. Consider what gives your life genuine meaning, and move in that direction.
eight-of-cups.sym_person: A traveler turning away from eight cups under the moonlight, walking toward the mountains
eight-of-cups.sym_symbol: Eight cups arranged neatly, a staff, and a night sky with the moon
eight-of-cups.sym_bg: A quiet night river lit by moonlight
eight-of-cups.upright: The eight neatly stacked cups represent the achievements, relationships, and familiar circumstances carefully built up until now. And yet the traveler turns his back on them, walking toward the mountains beneath the moonlight. This symbolizes a decision made by following a sense of incompleteness that lingers even in situations that appear outwardly sufficient. This card speaks not of fleeing from failure, but of the mature choice to relocate oneself in search of something that can no longer be found here. Like the figure walking alone with a staff, the core of this card is the courage to take a step forward even without complete certainty.
eight-of-cups.reversed: In reverse, this card can appear as remaining beside the familiar cups despite knowing that it's time to leave. It shows a state of being rooted in place due to fear, lingering attachment, or a lack of confidence in handling what comes after change. Alternatively, it can be read as avoiding the situation like a flight without clear reason, hastily ending a relationship or position. What's needed now is a balanced process of resolution—neither turning away from your feelings nor discarding things impulsively.
eight-of-cups.love: Even if the current relationship seems stable or outwardly unremarkable, this card points to an emotion deep within that continues to feel unfulfilled. Rather than searching for fault in your partner, it's time to ask yourself whether this relationship is emotionally sufficient for who you are now. Instead of rushing to a conclusion, an attitude of slowly confirming the direction your heart is leaning—like the traveler walking under the moonlight—will be helpful.
eight-of-cups.career: Your current job or position may be stable and look fine to others, yet you may feel stagnant in terms of growth or meaning. This card raises a question not about conditions but about direction, suggesting it may be time to leave your current place and move toward new learning or a new role. Before making a decision, it helps to first clarify not what you lack, but what you want to move toward.
eight-of-cups.money: Financially, even if there's no immediate difficulty, you may sense that your current income or asset structure doesn't align with the life you truly want. This card isn't telling you to give up a stable source of income—rather, it's a signal to examine the gap between the satisfaction money provides and the meaning of your life. If you're considering change, it's important to prepare practically alongside any emotional impulse.
eight-of-cups.advice: Start by acknowledging that having enough doesn't necessarily mean feeling fulfilled. Leaving isn't a sign of failure—it can be a natural transition toward a more authentic direction. Even without certainty about every answer, try taking one step at a time toward where your heart quietly points.

seven-of-cups.name: Seven of Cups
seven-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes illusion, confusion of choice, and temptation. Faced with many possibilities, you may not know what to choose, and the line between reality and fantasy has become blurred. Some options may look appealing but could be unrealizable dreams. Clarify what you truly desire and focus on realistic choices.
seven-of-cups.sym_person: A dark silhouetted figure stands before multiple visions
seven-of-cups.sym_symbol: Seven cups in the clouds (castle, treasure, snake, figure, laurel wreath, dragon, shining form)
seven-of-cups.upright: The seven cups rising within the clouds each contain something different—a castle, treasure, a snake, a figure, a laurel wreath, a dragon, a shining form—showing a state where it's difficult to judge which to choose. Like the figure shown only as a silhouette, you may currently be captivated by the dazzling possibilities in front of you without any clear sense of your own standards. Every cup seems appealing, but some of them may be nothing more than insubstantial dreams or fantasies of gaining something without effort. This card signals a time rich in imagination and possibility, while also warning that this very abundance can become a trap that delays decision-making. Distinguishing what you truly want from what merely looks appealing is the most necessary task at this stage.
seven-of-cups.reversed: The reversed Seven of Cups represents a gradual shift from a gaze lost in dreams toward a descent into reality. This may be the moment you actually pick one option among many and begin to act on it, or conversely, the moment you awaken from illusion and realize that what you were chasing was never real. As clarity arrives, priorities become sorted out, but this is often accompanied by a bittersweet recognition of reality. Either way, it is now time to make concrete judgments standing on solid ground, rather than imagining things above the clouds.
seven-of-cups.love: In love, this card shows a state where your feelings remain unsorted among several emotions or several people. Your expectations of the other person may be inflated beyond who they actually are, so rather than idealizing the relationship, you need to view it as it truly is. Asking yourself what kind of relationship you genuinely want is the first step toward reducing this confusion.
seven-of-cups.career: In career or work matters, this card indicates a time when various opportunities or offers appear before you at once, and you need to calmly assess which of them are actually achievable. Rather than being swayed into a hasty decision by attractive-looking conditions, it helps to compare the actual terms of each option against your own capabilities. The flow stabilizes when you focus on what can be turned into a tangible plan, rather than chasing a vague ideal.
seven-of-cups.money: In matters of money, several seemingly promising investment offers or profit opportunities may appear, but judging them without fully verifying what lies beneath the surface can be risky. The more attractive the conditions appear, the more carefully you should examine their grounds and feasibility—this is how you avoid loss. Rather than spreading your funds across uncertain options, it is safer now to thoroughly examine just one.
seven-of-cups.advice: Right now, rather than letting your heart be captured by the dazzling options in front of you, take time to pause and sort out what you truly want. If you try to chase every possibility at once, you may end up grasping none of them properly, so it's important to find the courage to choose one and take a realistic step forward. Fantasy can inspire you, but remember that it is concrete action that ultimately turns it into reality.

nine-of-cups.name: Nine of Cups
nine-of-cups.meaning: Known as the "wish card," it symbolizes the fulfillment of wishes, satisfaction, and emotional abundance. This is a time when what you desire comes true and your wants and needs are met. It represents a state of fully enjoying life's pleasures and joys, and when you clearly identify what you want, a strong energy is at work helping you achieve it.
nine-of-cups.sym_person: A man sitting with his arms crossed and a satisfied expression
nine-of-cups.sym_symbol: Nine cups arranged in a semicircle, blue drapery decoration
nine-of-cups.upright: The relaxed posture of the man sitting with crossed arms reflects a state of mind where there's no longer a need to strive for anything—a point where what was desired has already been obtained or is about to be. The nine cups lined up in a semicircle behind him represent the emotional experiences and efforts accumulated over time, now displayed as a single culmination, symbolizing the conviction that one has been filled without lack. This card focuses less on material success and more on the question of "am I actually feeling the satisfaction I wanted?"—signaling that this is a time when personal wishes are being fulfilled. The blue drapery and cozy background emphasize that this satisfaction comes not from showing off, but from a quiet, private sense of fullness. However, care is needed not to settle so comfortably into this ease that you miss the next opportunity for growth; an attitude of enjoying the current abundance while keeping your perspective open is also needed.
nine-of-cups.reversed: In reverse, even though the nine cups are filled, it indicates a state where the heart fails to fully feel that abundance. On the surface it may look as though you've obtained what you wanted, but inside there may remain emptiness, excessive self-satisfaction, or an unfilled hunger. It's also possible that in the process of your wishes coming true, things drifted toward other people's opinions or material standards rather than the genuine emotional fulfillment you originally sought. In such times, it helps to take a moment to revisit what you truly wanted, rather than focusing on how much you've obtained.
nine-of-cups.love: Within the relationship, mutual satisfaction and emotional stability have taken firm root, showing that simply being together flows comfortably and joyfully. If single, this may be a time when a long-awaited connection, or an equally exciting encounter, arrives to fill an emptiness in your heart. However, balance is needed to check whether the satisfaction in the relationship stems purely from self-centered expectations, and to also pay attention to your partner's feelings.
nine-of-cups.career: This is a time when the efforts you've built up return as the results or recognition you hoped for, bringing a sense of reaching a point of personal satisfaction. There's a possibility that concrete goals—such as completing a project, a promotion, or moving into a desired position—may be realized. However, rather than settling into this achievement, keeping a mindset of leaving room beside the filled cup for a new one will make the flow ahead even more abundant.
nine-of-cups.money: Financially, this may be a time when your plans come to fruition, bringing a sense of ease and stability, with savings or investments showing satisfying results. You may feel you've secured the level of stability you wanted without taking major risks. However, it's wise to also set up a plan to maintain this abundance, so that spending doesn't loosen up out of complacency.
nine-of-cups.advice: Acknowledge the satisfaction and fullness you feel right now just as it is, and don't feel guilty about enjoying it. At the same time, like the one remaining space beside the nine cups, take time to honestly look at what part still isn't completely filled. The more clearly you know what you want, the greater your power to achieve it becomes—so within this current flow, try once more to clarify what you truly desire.

ten-of-cups.name: Ten of Cups
ten-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes emotional fulfillment, family happiness, and true contentment. It represents a peaceful, happy life shared with loved ones, where emotional satisfaction has reached its peak. It signifies deep connection and belonging within a community. Treasure the domestic happiness and emotional fulfillment you are currently enjoying or are about to achieve.
ten-of-cups.sym_person: A harmonious family rejoicing with open arms beneath a rainbow
ten-of-cups.sym_symbol: A rainbow and ten cups, children playing, a house and a river
ten-of-cups.upright: Beneath a rainbow arching across the sky, two people stand with arms outstretched, while children play freely by the riverside. This scene may look like nothing more than an ordinary evening repeated day after day, but within it lies trust and affection built up over a long time. The ten cups arranged in a line across the sky suggest that emotion, rather than overflowing and disappearing, has found a stable place to settle. This card speaks of a comfort within relationships where one no longer needs to prove anything, a sense of belonging that comes from being accepted just as you are. It can be read as a signal to fully feel, rather than take for granted, the time spent with those around you now, or the harmonious circle you are building for the future.
ten-of-cups.reversed: In reversed position, the scene beneath the rainbow appears slightly out of alignment. Things may look harmonious on the surface, but communication may actually have broken down, or unspoken hurt may have accumulated between family members or partners. Alternatively, you might be comparing your own reality to the happiness others seem to display, feeling an emptiness that isn't being filled. This card encourages you to look again at what true satisfaction really means, and to examine the substance of your relationships rather than their outward appearance.
ten-of-cups.love: This is a time when feelings for each other are settling into stability, and simply being together may feel comfortable in itself. If you're already in a relationship, this card signals that trust is deepening. If you're seeking a new connection, you can look forward to a sincere bond emerging naturally rather than through urgency. However, it's important not to let comfort lead to neglecting the expression of your feelings for one another.
ten-of-cups.career: This may be a time when relationships with colleagues and team harmony bring greater satisfaction than achievements at work. Even without a notable promotion or major accomplishment, trust among those you work with can ultimately lead to stable growth. If you're considering a career change, finding the environment where you truly feel comfortable and a sense of belonging may be an important criterion for your decision.
ten-of-cups.money: Financially, this is a time centered less on major changes and more on the sense of stability shared with family or close ones. Rather than pursuing risky investments or expansion, sharing small satisfactions within what you already have suits this period better. It's worth remembering that money carries greater meaning when used as a tool for relationships.
ten-of-cups.advice: Don't take the time spent with those around you for granted—try to express the comfort you feel today more often. Remember that moments shared together, rather than flawless achievement, are often the happiness that lasts the longest. Rather than chasing a spectacular outcome like a rainbow, it may help to first look back at the warmth already present right where you are.

page-of-cups.name: Page of Cups
page-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes emotional inspiration, dreams, and messages from intuition. It represents a youthful energy overflowing with sensitivity and creativity, indicating intuitive messages or inspiration arriving from unexpected places. It reflects a state of being honest with your emotions and open to artistic expression. Pay attention to the voice of intuition whispering within you right now, and express your feelings creatively.
page-of-cups.sym_person: A young figure wearing floral-patterned clothing, holding a cup, with a fish leaping out from within the cup
page-of-cups.sym_symbol: A fish emerging from the cup, floral-patterned clothing
page-of-cups.upright: The Page of Cups captures the moment of gazing into a cup on a calm beach and suddenly encountering a fish leaping out from within it. This symbolizes not a logically prepared message, but intuition or inspiration that suddenly surfaces at a completely unexpected moment. As shown by the floral-patterned clothing, you are likely in a period of pure and open emotional expression, viewing the world anew with childlike curiosity. An unexpected confession, proposal, or creative idea from someone may suddenly arrive, and it would be wise to feel it first rather than analyze it immediately. This card tells you that you are at the stage of beginnings rather than results, of seeds rather than completion.
page-of-cups.reversed: In reverse, like a fish disappearing from the cup or water turning murky, this indicates a state of missing emotional signals or failing to trust your own intuition. Heightened sensitivity may instead turn into oversensitivity or emotional swings, leading you to misread someone's words or blow up stories in your imagination. Additionally, what was once pure emotional expression may come across as childish or immature, causing misunderstandings in relationships. This is a time when you need to distinguish between your inner voice and outside noise.
page-of-cups.love: In love, this shows a flow where your heart may open unexpectedly, or you may receive an unforeseen confession from someone. Expressing your feelings honestly could lead the relationship to a new stage, so it may be good to approach things following your heart rather than calculation. However, if reversed, it's worth checking whether you're being swept away by emotion, misreading the other person's intentions, or holding excessive expectations.
page-of-cups.career: In work and career, this is a period when a sudden idea or gut feeling may become an important clue, rather than a logical plan. Projects requiring artistic sense or creative thinking, or curiosity about a new field, may naturally take root. However, since this is still the stage of conceptualizing rather than concrete execution, it helps to let ideas fully mature rather than rushing toward results.
page-of-cups.money: Financially, this suggests a flow where an unexpected offer, a bit of good fortune, or an idea for a new income source may come to mind. However, this is closer to a seed of possibility than a confirmed outcome, so rather than making hasty investments or spending decisions based on hunches, a careful, watchful attitude is needed. If reversed, be cautious, as emotional judgment could lead to impulsive spending.
page-of-cups.advice: Don't ignore the feelings or thoughts that suddenly surface right now—pause for a moment and look into them. Even if they can't be explained logically, they may be signals coming from deep within you. Face the world with a pure, childlike heart, but find the balance of refining for yourself how to express those feelings.

five-of-cups.name: Five of Cups
five-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes loss, regret, and sorrow. It represents a state of fixating on losses that have already occurred while failing to see what still remains. Dwelling on the past and mourning what has been lost is a necessary process, but there comes a time, after grief has been fully felt, to turn one's attention to what remains. Lift your eyes from what has been lost and look toward the value of what you still have.
five-of-cups.sym_person: A figure wrapped in a black cloak looks down at three fallen cups
five-of-cups.sym_symbol: Three spilled cups, two upright cups standing behind, a castle across the bridge
five-of-cups.upright: The figure in the black cloak stands with their back turned, staring only at the three fallen cups. Behind them stand two cups still intact, yet their grief-stricken gaze never turns that way. This card depicts a deep regret and mourning felt in the face of a loss that has already occurred, a missed opportunity, or a broken relationship. The dim, desolate riverbank setting speaks to how heavy and isolating this moment's emotions feel, yet the castle visible across the bridge suggests that a path forward still exists beyond the grief. Now may be a time to fully acknowledge and work through the feelings of loss, rather than forcing yourself to appear fine.
five-of-cups.reversed: In the reversed position, this can be read as the figure slowly turning their head, beginning to notice the two cups remaining behind them. It indicates a movement away from long-held sorrow or self-blame, or a stage of accepting what has already passed and beginning to recover. However, since unresolved attachment may linger, or one may revisit the past and feel pain again, the pace of recovery can vary from person to person. What matters is not forcibly pushing away grief, but waiting for the moment when your gaze naturally turns forward.
five-of-cups.love: This shows a state where the heart remains fixed on broken trust in a relationship or the sense of loss following a breakup. Lingering attachment to a past person or a missed opportunity may be clouding your view of your current relationship or a new encounter. But like the two cups still standing behind, if there is someone beside you now, or feelings that are still alive, recognizing them can be the beginning of healing.
five-of-cups.career: A failed project, a missed promotion, or results that fell short of expectations may be weighing heavily on your mind. If you remain fixed on regret over what has already happened, you risk overlooking opportunities or resources that still remain. Now may be a time to acknowledge failure rather than deny it, while also remembering that, like the castle visible across the bridge, a reachable next step still lies ahead.
five-of-cups.money: This may indicate a state of being disheartened by investment losses or unexpected expenses. Fixating on money already lost makes it difficult to clearly assess the assets that remain or plan realistically for the future. Only after going through a process of acknowledging and accepting the loss can a practical financial plan based on what remains become possible.
five-of-cups.advice: Rather than forcing away the sense of loss and regret you feel now, allow yourself enough time to grieve. However, so that this time does not stretch on endlessly, you must create a moment to turn your head and look at what still remains beside you. Just as the castle is visible across the river, remember that there is still a path to walk beyond the grief.

two-of-pentacles.name: Two of Pentacles
two-of-pentacles.meaning: This card symbolizes balance, adaptability, and the management of change. It represents the ability to balance multiple situations or responsibilities, and a state of flexibly handling financial ups and downs. You may not be able to do everything perfectly, but you can coordinate things wisely. Right now, flexible response matters more than perfection, so set your priorities and manage things with balance.
two-of-pentacles.sym_person: A man juggling two coins within an infinity loop
two-of-pentacles.sym_bg: A sea with ships tossed among the waves
two-of-pentacles.upright: The figure juggling two coins with both hands shows not a state of perfect stillness, but the very process of maintaining balance through constant motion. The infinity loop surrounding him suggests that this juggling is not a temporary feat but a rhythm that will continue to repeat throughout life. The churning waves and swaying ships in the background tell us that the external environment is never calm, yet he keeps moving forward, riding the rhythm regardless. This symbolizes the state of someone carrying multiple roles or responsibilities at once, flexibly coordinating them without any perfect solution. What you need right now is not the ability to handle everything perfectly all at once, but the sense of continually shifting your center of gravity to respond to the flow.
two-of-pentacles.reversed: This brings to mind a moment when the juggling rhythm has broken down, and one coin is about to be dropped. Trying to hold onto too many things at once can scatter your priorities, leaving you unable to focus on what truly matters. As the waves grow rougher, external pressures may intensify faster than your ability to respond, causing cracks to appear in your finances or schedule management. At such times, you need to let go of the desire to hold onto everything and coolly determine what must be set aside first.
two-of-pentacles.love: This indicates a period when two people with different life rhythms are finding a point of balance within their relationship. The question of how to divide time between work and love, or among various relationships, may emerge as a central theme. Rather than obsessively pursuing perfect balance, adopting a flexible attitude that adjusts according to circumstances will make the relationship more comfortable.
two-of-pentacles.career: This suggests a situation where you must juggle multiple tasks or projects at once, which tests your abilities while also offering an opportunity for growth. In a work environment that shifts like waves, plans may need frequent revision, making flexible responsiveness the key to results. Right now, the practical sense to quickly reprioritize according to the situation carries more weight than any perfect manual.
two-of-pentacles.money: This shows a period when you need to balance income and expenses, or various financial categories. Cash flow may rise and fall like waves, so securing some reserve funds can provide a sense of stability. Rather than overextending, an approach of coordinating within your current resources while watching how things unfold is the wiser choice.
two-of-pentacles.advice: Rather than trying to do everything perfectly at the same time, try shifting your center of gravity for a moment toward whatever feels most unstable right now. Like the infinity loop, life's rhythm continues on, so there's no need to react too heavily to a single mistake. The rougher the waves get, the more it helps to slow down and take time to reassess your priorities in order to regain your balance.

knight-of-cups.name: Knight of Cups
knight-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes romantic pursuit, emotional invitation, and artistic expression. It carries a romantic energy that moves slowly toward love and ideals, and may bring joyful news or an emotional proposal. It represents a charming energy that seeks to turn dreams and ideals into reality. Follow the voice of your heart, speak sincerely, and move forward with emotionally genuine action.
knight-of-cups.sym_person: A knight wearing a winged helmet and boots rides slowly on horseback, holding a cup
knight-of-cups.sym_symbol: Winged helmet and boots, armor patterned with waves, a white horse
knight-of-cups.sym_bg: A landscape with a river and mountains
knight-of-cups.upright: The Knight of Cups sits upon a white horse, moving slowly toward a landscape where a river flows, showing an unhurried romantic attitude. His winged helmet and boots symbolize a longing to move freely in the direction his heart leads, without losing his grounded sense of reality. The cup he holds represents the vessel of emotion he carries carefully, offering a sincere invitation to another—this could be a confession of love or inspiration for creative work. His wave-patterned armor shows an outer protective shell, while the sensitivity flowing within remains flexible and delicate, and the background of river and mountains represents a journey in which emotion and reality gradually come into harmony. Overall, this card conveys the energy of a mature romantic who moves toward an ideal while knowing how to pace themselves along the way.
knight-of-cups.reversed: In reverse, just as the water in the knight's cup might spill or ripple unsteadily, this suggests emotions may be expressed in an exaggerated or inconsistent way. A mind too fixated on chasing ideals may fail to properly see the other person's reality, and sweet words or offers may lack real substance behind them. At times, this can also show a state of indecision—unable to confidently move forward or step back due to uncertainty about one's own feelings. This may be a time to check whether you've been swept up by surface charm or atmosphere in a way that has clouded your judgment.
knight-of-cups.love: In the upright position, a gentle invitation or confession may be coming your way from someone, and taking your time to express your feelings without rushing can help the relationship develop smoothly. If you're already in a relationship, this is a favorable flow for deepening romantic moments and emotional connection in the time you spend together. In reverse, rather than getting swept away by sweet words or a pleasant atmosphere, it would help to calmly check the true warmth behind the other person's feelings.
knight-of-cups.career: In terms of work, you may receive an offer involving creativity or emotionally sensitive communication with others, and it would be more favorable to follow the natural flow rather than pushing things forward hastily. There's a possibility of recognition or good opportunities in fields that deal with the heart, such as art, counseling, or service. In reverse, it may be time to check whether an idea is being prioritized over practical preparation, or whether a proposal that looks appealing actually has real substance behind it.
knight-of-cups.money: Financially, this flow suggests spending decisions made for emotional reasons, or money moving between people in the form of gifts or thoughtful gestures within a relationship. Rather than large profits, there's a possibility of gentle income related to expressive spending or creative work. In reverse, be careful of spending without a plan, carried away by mood or expectation, and it would help to double-check things in concrete numbers.
knight-of-cups.advice: Right now, move step by step in the direction your heart leads, but allow yourself the ease to pace that movement yourself. If there's someone you wish to be sincere with, or an ideal you hope to achieve, a steady and genuine attitude will leave a longer-lasting impression than flashy words. So as not to be swept away by emotions that ripple like water, step forward wearing the boots of practical groundedness, firmly laced.

queen-of-cups.name: Queen of Cups
queen-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes emotional maturity, deep empathic ability, and intuitive wisdom. The Queen of Cups possesses a natural capacity to understand and heal others' emotions, with a rich and profound inner world. She represents the maturity to balance and integrate feeling with reason. Right now, you may need the ability to read the emotions hidden behind others' words and connect through deep empathy.
queen-of-cups.sym_person: A queen seated by the water, holding an ornately crafted cup with both hands and gazing into it
queen-of-cups.sym_symbol: An elaborate covered cup, a throne carved with mermaids and shells
queen-of-cups.upright: The Queen of Cups holds an elaborately crafted, lidded cup carefully in both hands. This represents a maturity that doesn't let emotions spill out carelessly, but instead knows how to protect and govern their depths within herself. The mermaids and shells carved into her throne show that she is fully rooted in the watery realm—the domain of the unconscious and emotion—yet is never swept away by its currents. Seated against the backdrop of a calm sea, this card speaks of the power to quietly sense and hold the true feelings that lie beneath others' words and expressions. You may now be facing a situation where intuition should lead before logic, or a moment when you need to accept someone's heart exactly as it is.
queen-of-cups.reversed: When the cup is overturned, the emotions it holds may either overflow or shut down completely. This can indicate a state where you've lost yourself by over-identifying with others' feelings, or conversely, have grown numb and cold from suppressing emotion for too long. It may be time to ask whether you're carrying someone else's burdens out of indulgent sympathy rather than true empathy, or whether you've locked your heart away out of fear of being hurt. During this period, the priority is finding a healthy distance between yourself and your emotions once again.
queen-of-cups.love: This is a time when your sensitivity to the true feelings hidden behind a partner's tone and expressions may come alive. Quietly staying by their side and listening, rather than arguing, can deepen the relationship. However, you'll need to maintain balance so that in focusing on reading the other person's emotions, you don't lose touch with your own heart.
queen-of-cups.career: This may be a period when your ability to sensitively read the emotions of colleagues or clients becomes a real strength at work. You might feel an especially good flow in fields that deal with people's hearts, such as counseling, caregiving, or creative work. However, when you need to make a clear-headed judgment about an emotionally tangled issue, it's also wise to step back and create distance, as if closing the lid on the cup.
queen-of-cups.money: This is a period when emotions may play a significant role in your financial decisions, so it's worth carefully watching for impulsive spending or expenses driven too much by sentiment. On the other hand, your intuition may give surprisingly accurate signals when planning your finances, so it's worth considering not just the numbers but whether a choice feels right in your heart. If money matters involve family or close relationships, tending to feelings first can help reduce conflict.
queen-of-cups.advice: Right now is a time to accept others' emotions as they are rather than judge them, and to simply stay present beside them. Don't ignore the deep feelings within you—look into them carefully and hold them gently, as you would a cup. Empathy, to last, must be built on a sense of balance that protects yourself even as it serves others.

king-of-cups.name: King of Cups
king-of-cups.meaning: This card symbolizes mastery over emotions, balanced wisdom, and mature empathy. It represents an inner stability that remains unshaken even amid emotional storms. It carries the leadership quality of integrating intellect and feeling to guide others wisely. With the maturity to control emotions without suppressing them, this may be a time to exercise wise judgment and compassion.
king-of-cups.sym_person: A king seated on a throne above the waves, holding a cup
king-of-cups.sym_symbol: A fish pendant necklace, a throne upon a turbulent sea, a ship and a fish visible in the distance
king-of-cups.upright: The King of Cups is a figure who sits upon a throne set amid rough waves, yet keeps the cup in his hand steady and unspilled. This represents a maturity that holds its center even when emotions run high, symbolizing the ability to fully feel one's emotions without being swept away by them. The fish pendant around his neck signals an understanding of the unconscious and intuitive realms, while the ship and fish visible in the distance represent a sense of balance that navigates the depths of emotion without losing sight of the course of reality. If this card appears, you may be at a point where you can deeply consider others' feelings while also exercising clear, calm judgment at the same time. This may be a moment calling for the generosity and wisdom that only someone who holds both emotion and reason together can show.
king-of-cups.reversed: The reversed King of Cups shows a state where control over emotions is slipping away, much like a throne rocked by waves. Though appearing calm on the surface, suppressed feelings may be building up inside and leaking out as irritability or moodiness. At times, this may appear as losing balance between two extremes—being overly swayed by others' emotions, or conversely, suppressing one's own feelings so much that one becomes numb. In such moments, it may help to first take quiet time to look inward at your emotions rather than avoiding them.
king-of-cups.love: In love, this card may suggest a mature relationship built on deeply understanding and accepting a partner's heart. There is a flow of building trust by maintaining composure even amid a partner's or situation's emotional ups and downs. However, it may also be worth checking in with yourself about whether you've been holding back too much of your own feelings.
king-of-cups.career: At work or in one's career path, there is a possibility of taking on the role of staying calm and grounded amid colleagues or situations that are emotionally unsettled. In positions requiring leadership, a way of combining logic with empathy may lead to good results. This card's energy may be especially well expressed in roles involving conflict resolution, counseling, or mediation.
king-of-cups.money: In matters of money, a calm, watchful attitude may be more helpful than emotional impulse purchases or spontaneous investments. Even if there is stress from financial issues, calmly grasping the overall flow may help you find a stable direction. This may be an especially important time to set emotion aside and make rational judgments, particularly in financial matters involving others.
king-of-cups.advice: This may be a time to practice acknowledging your emotions while still managing them, rather than suppressing them. Even when the waves grow rough, try holding your position like the king seated upon his throne. The composure to consider others' feelings first may, in the end, bring greater peace to your own heart as well.

three-of-pentacles.name: Three of Pentacles
three-of-pentacles.meaning: This card symbolizes skill, collaboration, and craftsmanship. It represents teamwork in which each person plays their role to create something greater together. When planning and skill combine, exceptional results emerge, and this marks a stage where expertise is recognized and further developed. Rather than working alone, combining ideas and skills as a team can lead to greater achievements.
three-of-pentacles.sym_person: A stonemason carving a church pillar, along with a monk or noble holding architectural plans
three-of-pentacles.sym_symbol: Three pentacles, architectural blueprints, a church arch
three-of-pentacles.sym_bg: The interior of a church or monastery
three-of-pentacles.upright: The image of a stonemason with chisel in hand, working on a church pillar, symbolizes work that cannot be completed through individual effort alone. Just as a single arch comes together fully only when the person holding the blueprint, the one carving, and another set of watching eyes all work in harmony, what you are doing now also achieves true completeness when the hands and eyes of multiple people come together. This card goes beyond simple cooperation to show a stage where someone who has honed their expertise begins to have that skill recognized. Like the three pentacles carved side by side, the outcome becomes solid when personal skill, team direction, and a clear plan align in three parts. Now is a time to find meaning in the process of building something together, rather than struggling alone.
three-of-pentacles.reversed: In reverse, this can represent a situation like a stonemason swinging a chisel without a blueprint—where direction has become scattered and everyone is working from a different picture. In places where collaboration should occur, communication may break down, or someone's contribution may go unrecognized, creating cracks in teamwork. There is also a risk that rushing toward results while skipping the process of building skill could lead to work being finished with diminished quality. Now is a time to reexamine direction rather than speed, and the overall structure rather than individual achievement.
three-of-pentacles.love: In the upright position, this is a time when two people respect each other's roles and build the structure of their relationship together, where their differences can actually make the relationship stronger. For unrequited love, small acts of cooperation or shared activities that create points of connection with the other person could become an opportunity to open their heart. However, in reverse, it's worth checking through conversation whether only one side is putting in effort, or whether expectations between the two of you have drifted apart—realigning the blueprint, so to speak.
